newsitem.title: USA: LL&E Trust payout up slightly.
newsitem.headline: LL&E Trust payout up slightly.

text.p: LL&E Royalty Trust said Friday its October income distribution, representing production for the month of July, would be $0.0519, payable October 15 to holders of record on October 7.
This month's distribution was $0.496 per unit.

The trust said this distribution includes no proceeds from Offshore Louisiana due to increased capital expenditures. Excess production costs to be recouped from future proceeds from Offshore Louisiana totaled $37,700.
Also, this distribution includes no proceeds from Fort Worth Basin. Remaining excess production costs to be recouped from future proceeds from Fort Worth Basin total $10,500.
The Trust noted its interest is equivalent to 90 percent of the net proceeds from Offshore Louisiana and Fort Worth Basin.
It said the estimated dismantlement cost for the trust's Offshore Louisiana property is $2.0 million and $2.4 million has been escrowed for future dismantlement
